answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust-style matrix, a freshly spawned identity has near-zero eigenvector centrality without credible paths from trusted peers; reciprocity-weighted transitivity limits borrowed trust. A sybil cluster therefore cannot gain consensus weight simply by multiplying identities. A ledge, lantern, or raven may label a node, but none replaces verified history.
